en: Sepia-toned vintage photograph of a rural village street. On the left is a traditional house with a steep tiled roof and wooden fence. A dirt road curves into the distance, lined with young trees and telegraph poles. Two children stand by the fence while two women in long dresses walk away along the road. In the background, beyond open fields, stands a church with a tall pointed steeple surrounded by village houses. The printed caption at the top right reads "DEUTSCH-EINSIEDEL im Erzgeb."
